skills.name: capture-account-evidence
skills.when: Authorized coursework sources need browser intake.

inputs: Rubric/original material and user's unaided attempt; label the diagnosis unknown if absent.
Optional: the LearnHarness data folder (default per OS, or --data-dir) and a prior socratic-tutor save-state block.
steps: For ongoing study, start with study-loop: review what learnq.py due lists before new material.
If LearnHarness data exists, read the learner's own answers, confidence and thinking. Treat graph propositions as topics met, not mastery.
Identify one gap from the attempt or history, or run a short diagnostic. History picks which diagnostic questions come first; it never sets levels.
Teach that gap using the source evidence. At level 0-1 use study-loop's worked-example beginner mode; from level 2 use the socratic-tutor loop.
Prepare a fresh unaided check without treating generated answers as mastery. Levels 4-5 need a code, checker or human grader. Use exam-prep when the check must match a real exam format.
Record each check in the study-loop queue. On pause, emit the socratic-tutor save-state block. Write nothing into the LearnHarness data folder.
learn.check: Observe a fresh human attempt against a rubric; agent output is preparation evidence.
learn.stop: Targeted help and fresh check prepared, or actual attempt establishes the intended learning.
learn.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization. LearnHarness data is read-only.
